footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to StubHub: after $86.5M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.4% to $1.7B in 2025. Gross margin was 82.0%, versus 81.1% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $1.3B, versus operating income of $138M.
The net loss widened to $2.0B, or −$6.27 per share, from $55.1M. Operating cash flow was $193M and free cash flow $191M, versus $260M; StubHub returned $1.0M through buybacks.
sources: StubHub Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
